annotations.title: Set an app's goal, markets and constraints

description: Writes the brief Apptiller's agent works from for one app. Fields left out stay as they are. goal: what a good result is, as a cost per paying subscriber, per trial or per install (with its currency) or a ROAS (revenue over spend, e.g. 1.2), or null to clear it. countries: the markets that matter most, as two-letter codes. competitors: apps the user names as competitors (names or App Store ids). constraints: plain words the agent must respect, such as a launch date or campaigns not to touch. facts: short facts by key (prices, seasonality, anything the agent should know); a null value removes one. The agent never overwrites what the user set here. These come from the user.

currency.description: ISO currency of a cost goal, e.g. USD. Not for roas.
